R/ PART ARAB PART ADIAB COSS II PP

A Roman silver coin: a denarius of Septimus Severus (AD193-211), Two Captives under a trophy, PART ARAB PART ADIAB COSS II PP reverse type, dating from 195 AD. There is a small chip from the flan at six o'clock on the obverse. It is 17.2mm in diameter and 1.9mm thick. It weighs 2.55gm. It is possible that the coin is a contemporary plated copy. Compare Sear Volume II number 6322 for the reverse…
